t: The Grand Key-Words for the Relief Society
r: Second Counselor in the First Presidency

t: May We Be Faithful and True
ds: The Lord is watching over His kingdom. He is inspiring its leadership to care for its ever-growing membership.
r: President of the Church

ds: Imagine the consoling, liberating, exalting feeling that will come to you when you see the reality of the Atonement and the practical, everyday value of it to you individually.
r: Acting President of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles

ds: The redeeming presence of our loving Father-God in the universe is the … supernal truth which, along with His plan of happiness, reigns preeminent and imperial over all other realities.
r: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles

t: Caring for the Souls of Children
ds: Tell your children that you love them and that you are so happy to have them in your family. Prepare yourselves spiritually to receive guidance through the Holy Ghost.
r: Primary General President

ds: Maintaining our spiritual strength is … a daily challenge. The greatest source of that spiritual strength comes … from our temples.
r: Second Counselor in the First Presidency

ds: [Your] most important stewardship is the glorious responsibility your Father in Heaven has given you to watch over and care for your own soul.
r: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles
Chairman, Church Audit Committee

ds: The burden [of a bishop] is a heavy one that cannot be fulfilled without the supportive efforts of ward officers and members.
r: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles

ds: We may know that the warning is from the Lord [when] the law of witnesses, authorized witnesses, has been invoked. When the words of prophets seem repetitive, that should rivet our attention.
r: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles

ds: Every member must come to know the sacred nature of his or her own service in the Church.
r: Of the Presidency of the Seventy

ds: For members of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, honesty is the only policy.
r: Of the Seventy

ds: Just as Jesus’ anxious Apostles were given peace by “another Comforter,” so today can all men and women receive the same marvelous blessing each day of their lives.
r: Of the Seventy

ds: I express gratitude and love for Jesus Christ and His Atonement, for His willingness to leave the realms of the heavens as a God and come to earth as a lowly babe.
r: Of the Seventy

ds: If you try your best to be the best parent you can be, you will have done all that a human being can do and all that God expects you to do.
r: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles

ds: Caring for others is the very essence of priesthood responsibility. It is the power to bless, to heal, and to administer the saving ordinances of the gospel.
r: Second Counselor in the First Presidency

ds: Learn to be … obedient above all things—that you might be able to carry out the Lord’s work in the majestic way in which it must be done.
r: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles

t: “In His Strength I Can Do All Things”
ds: Ordinary men, blessed with the privilege of holding the priesthood of God, may be called upon to do extraordinary tasks and accomplish mighty feats through faith in that sacred power!
r: Of the Presidency of the Seventy

ds: Let us, with faith unwavering and with love unstinting, be bridge builders to the hearts of those with whom we labor.
r: First Counselor in the First Presidency

ds: Jesus Christ, Savior of the world … was and is the ultimate pioneer, for He has gone before, showing all others the way to follow.
r: First Counselor in the First Presidency

ds: Every convert is precious. Every convert is a son or daughter of God. Every convert is a great and serious responsibility.
r: President of the Church

ds: The Redeemer loves you and will help you do the essential things that bring happiness now and forever.
r: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles

ds: With so great an inheritance, we can do no less than our very best. Those who have gone before expect this of us. We have a mandate from the Lord.
r: President of the Church

t: “You Have Nothing to Fear from the Journey”
ds: No matter how difficult the trail … we can take comfort in knowing that others before us have borne life’s most grievous trials and tragedies by looking to heaven.
r: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles

ds: [The] responsibility to endure is uniquely yours. But you are never alone. I testify that the lifting power of the Lord can be yours.
r: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles

t: “That Spirit Which Leadeth to Do Good”
ds: The Holy Ghost will be our constant companion if we submit ourselves to the will of our Father in Heaven.
r: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles

ds: The time is past when we can merely believe in this gospel; we must be passionate in our belief and in our commitment to Jesus Christ and His plan.
r: Recently Released Relief Society General President

ds: [Can we] set aside our love of substance and hear the cry of the hungry, the needy, the naked, and the sick?
r: Presiding Bishop

t: “Pray unto the Father in My Name”
ds: When we use these sacred words, “in the name of Jesus Christ,” … we are on holy ground.
r: Of the Seventy

t: “When Thou Art Converted, Strengthen Thy Brethren”
ds: To become one in the family of Saints requires established members of the Church to warmly welcome new members with open arms.
r: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles

ds: God is at the helm. We will seek His direction. We will listen to the still, small voice of revelation. And we will go forward as He directs.
r: President of the Church

ds: Years from now your grandchildren will tell with amazement stories of your choices which changed their lives. You will be called their pioneers.
r: Second Counselor in the Young Women General Presidency
